items.proposition: Batch North preserved the intended shelf order, while its printed labels showed wrong years.
sourceQuotes: Batch North preserved the intended shelf order but its printed labels gave wrong years.
items.materiality: This records that the date and shelf-order dimensions can have different outcomes in the same batch.
items.boundary: It does not identify why the years were wrong or establish a cause of any error.

items.proposition: Batch South printed the years correctly but reversed shelf order.
sourceQuotes: Batch South printed the years correctly but reversed shelf order.
items.materiality: This independently shows that correct dates do not ensure correct shelf order.
items.boundary: It does not explain the reversal or establish a causal relationship between the two dimensions.

items.proposition: Batch West had both dates and shelf order correct.
sourceQuotes: Batch West had both dimensions correct.
items.materiality: This is a contrast case showing that both dimensions were correct in at least one batch.
items.boundary: It does not show how the batch achieved that result or establish that the same conditions apply to other batches.

items.proposition: The audit recommended checking dates and shelf order separately.
sourceQuotes: It recommended checking dates and shelf order separately.
items.materiality: This directly supports treating the two dimensions as separate checks.
items.boundary: It is a recommendation, not evidence that separate checks were implemented or that they improved results.

items.proposition: The audit did not identify a single earliest cause across the batches.
sourceQuotes: The audit found no single earliest cause across batches
items.materiality: This limits conclusions about a common cause for the observed errors.
items.boundary: It does not establish that no causes existed; it reports that the audit found no single earliest cause.

items.proposition: A missing intake log prevents attribution for Batch North.
sourceQuotes: a missing intake log prevents attribution for North.
items.materiality: This is a specific attribution limitation for North and cautions against assigning its error to a cause.
items.boundary: It does not state that attribution is impossible for every batch or identify what the missing log would have shown.

items.materiality: This prevents treating the audit as evidence about readers' comprehension.
items.boundary: It does not establish whether the labels affected comprehension; that outcome was not tested.

ideaChecks.proposition: Two audit dimensions need separate checks.

limitations: The source recommends separate checks but does not report that they were carried out.
The source does not identify causes for the batch outcomes, and specifically says North's attribution is prevented by a missing intake log.
